text: “In hopes some bees may make a nest in it—then I should get the honey.” “But you’ve got a bee-hive—or something like one—fastened to the saddle,” said Alice. “Yes, it’s a very good bee-hive,” the Knight said in a discontented tone, “one of the best kind. But not a single bee has come near it yet. And the other thing is a mouse-trap. I suppose the mice keep the bees out—or the bees keep the mice out, I don’t know which.” “I was wondering what the mouse-trap was for,” said Alice.
